project_summary.description: Three-Tier Canadian Retirement Planning Platform (Enterprise, Advisor, Solo) with PIPEDA compliance, CRM pluggable integrations, TOTP MFA, household records, and financial goal tracking.
project_summary.target_audience: Canadian residents, wealth advisors, financial planners, enterprise wealth firms

brand_identity.voice_and_tone: Trustworthy, authoritative, precise, PIPEDA-compliant, modern Canadian wealth management

usage_rules.gradient: Reserved ONLY for brand header accents, active CTA buttons, and key progress metrics. Never blanket whole pages.
usage_rules.navy: Used for main typography, structural titles, sidebars, and high-level card headers for visual weight.
usage_rules.muted_grey: Used for secondary metadata, subtitles, labels, table headers, and dormant status indicators.
usage_rules.accent_green: Used for active states, verified MFA badges, positive financial projections, and PIPEDA consent indicators.

scales.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold text-[#1B2559] tracking-tight

spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12 for generous padding in container cards to prevent text collision

tier_shells.enterprise: High-density CRM dashboard, Salesforce mock sync status, multi-advisor oversight, audit log table, PIPEDA breach/retention monitor.
tier_shells.advisor: Client roster view with instant household drill-down, asset allocation summary, goal progress tracker, promotion requests from Solo tier.
tier_shells.solo: Clean mobile-friendly personal retirement planner, CPP/OAS/RRSP/TFSA calculator, consent management toggle, promotion to Advisor flow.

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: The Tetris Grid for metrics and High Density Grid for data analytics tables and goal progress widgets.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out, hover:-translate-y-0.5 transform transition-transform duration-150
motion_and_interactions.prohibited_animations: No universal transition:all. No excessive spring effects in data tables.

component_guidelines.auth_mfa: Prominent MFA modal/step with 6-digit TOTP code input, copyable secret key, and mock QR code.
component_guidelines.pipeda_panel: Dedicated PIPEDA Compliance Drawer/Modal featuring: active consent toggles, Right-to-Access export (JSON/CSV download), Right-to-Erasure request modal, and Audit Log timeline.
component_guidelines.crm_connector: Pluggable Salesforce sync indicator card showing real-time sync status, last synced record timestamp, and Manual Re-sync trigger button.
component_guidelines.promotion_flow: Solo to Advisor/Enterprise promotion wizard with explicit PIPEDA consent re-capture, data sharing agreement, and advisor selection.
component_guidelines.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid="login-submit-button", data-testid="mfa-totp-input", data-testid="pipeda-export-btn").

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly enforce locked visual tokens across Enterprise, Advisor, and Solo tiers to prevent visual drift.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or floating headers; use solid or blurred backdrops.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit hover/active states with contrasting text.
Include data-testid on every button, input, tab, card, and modal for automated test suites.
Use Montserrat for Wordmark/H1-H3 headers and Inter for clean body and dashboard tables.
